Senior IPS Officer Appointed Director of Special Protection Group

The government has approved the appointment of senior IPS officer Amit Kumar as the new Director of the Special Protection Group (SPG). The SPG is responsible for the security of the Prime Minister and former Prime Ministers. This appointment is considered a high-profile move within the country's security and administrative apparatus.
